page.layout: One page of text, single column; a catchword-like word "Sed" at the lower right, below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Odium agrefte,pertinax & implacabile, & eius effecta atroces iniurias, vim,dolos, & Θ⁠ΥΜΟΣ... comitantur atroces & fatales poenae. Habet enim Deus παντων εφορω... ἐπιλυων ὑμᾶς: & stat illud Psalmis noftri: Tu autem Domine defcendere eos facies in puteum foueae, viri sanguinarij & dolofi non dimidiabunt dies suos, Psal.55.24.

Vos autem Idumaei, aeterno prope odio Ifraelitarum ardentes, quum templo & vrbe Ierofolyma à Nebucadnezare euerfis, audiretis infestas nomini Iudaico vicinas gentes, Epinicium, seu triumphale carmen, de sanctuarij desolatione & pollutione, & de domus Iehudae deportatione Babylonica, cantates, accinuistis ipsi quoque: vim Iudaeis feciftis pro virili veftra parte.

Quare atroces poenae, confusio videlicet & perpetuum excidium, veftram iniquitatem comitabuntur. Confusio autem erit, quando nec vos ipsi, nec alij, vobis laborantibus, subuenire: & malis veftris mederi poterunt. Excidium vero perpetuu, quia multis millibus veftrum occisis, caeteris deportatis in longinquas regiones, his nunqua licebit patrium solum repetere & incolere. Nunqua enim Idumaea gens, quasi postliminij iure recepta regione auita & patria, restituetur in integrum.

page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph are only partly legible at this scan resolution (the phrases "πάντων ἐφορῶ" and "ἐπιλύων ὑμᾶς" are my best reading and should be checked against the original; the word after "&" is also uncertain). The word "Θ…" marks an unreadable Greek word and is not a reliable transcription. Two words of the third paragraph, "accinuistis" and "veftram", read as printed. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Epinicium" , "perpetuu", "vobis laborantibus" (sic). The word "Sed" at the foot is a catchword.
